title: TomatoMod-Crops+
description: Adds tomatoes to Minecraft! Grow fresh crops, find wild herbs, and craft gourmet dishes like Tomato Soup and Caprese Salad. Fully supports 7 languages!
body:
# 🍅 Tomato | Fresh Crops & Italian Cuisine

**Tomato** is a modular expansion for the **Crops+** ecosystem. This mod brings a complete tomato farming experience and high-quality culinary options to your world, following our **"Zero-Waste" philosophy**.

Only want tomatoes? Just install this mod. No unnecessary items, no inventory bloat—just pure farming fun.

---

### ✨ Features

*   🌿 **Vine-Ripened Tomatoes:** Grow vibrant red tomatoes from seeds. Features high-definition textures that look great in any farm.
*   🍲 **Hearty Tomato Soup:** A nutritious soup made with 6 tomatoes and a bowl, following the classic beetroot soup style.
*   🧀 **Caprese Salad:** A gourmet dish combining fresh tomatoes, **Crops+ Cheese**, and **Wild Herbs**.
*   🌍 **Global Localization:** Fully translated into **7 major languages** from day one.

---

### 🚜 How to Start

1.  **Foraging:** Break grass or tall grass to find **Tomato Seeds** and **Wild Herbs** (8% chance).
2.  **Making Cheese:** Smelt a Milk Bucket in a furnace to get a **Cheese Bucket**, then craft it into **Cheese** (returns an empty bucket!).
3.  **Cultivate:** Plant your seeds and watch them grow through their stages.
4.  **Cooking:** Head to the crafting table to create delicious soups and salads using your harvest.


### 📦 Requirements / 必須環境
*   📦 **[Crops+](https://modrinth.com/mod/crops-plus)** (Core Library)
*   ⚙️ **Fabric API**

---

### 🌐 Supported Languages
English / 日本語 / 简体中文 / Русский / Español / Português / Deutsch

---

### 🛠️ Technical Info
*   **Platform:** Fabric
*   **Version:** 1.20.1
